quick: An avocado night cream can moisturise the thin skin under the eyes and make it look smoother, but it will not remove dark circles caused by genes, sleep or blood vessels. Pat a rice-grain amount on the bone under the eye, avoid the lash line and patch test first, because creams with kojic acid can sting.
facts: Dark circles have many causes; a cream helps only some.
Use a rice-grain amount on the bone, not the lash line.
Patch test first and stop if it stings.
Sleep, sunscreen and hydration matter as much.
